title: New Moon in Libra
tldr: A seed point for relationship, reciprocity, beauty, justice, consent, and the courage to choose cleanly.
theme: Libra is a cardinal air sign ruled traditionally by Venus. This New Moon begins work around relationship, reciprocity, beauty, justice, consent, and the courage to choose cleanly.
shadow: keeping peace at the expense of yourself, over-accommodating, or calling avoidance harmony
integration: creating balance that includes your needs too

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc reveals where compromise crossed into self-betrayal.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Libra; watch what the Aries Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Venus kamea, pink or white candle, rose quartz, copper, peridot, roses, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Libra. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through relationship, reciprocity, beauty, justice, consent, and the courage to choose cleanly, without repeating the shadow of keeping peace at the expense of yourself, over-accommodating, or calling avoidance harmony?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Libra intention take form?
